subject.title: feat(cli): add openclaw automations alias and reword cron display prose

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `automations` as a permanently supported public CLI alias and primary scheduler-facing name while retaining `cron` for compatibility?
rationale: The patch is additive, but it establishes a new long-lived public CLI contract and is part of an open RFC-driven naming stack; code review cannot determine whether that product direction is accepted.

options.title: Sponsor the additive alias
options.body: Adopt `openclaw automations` as the preferred documented command while retaining `openclaw cron` as a supported compatibility token.

options.title: Keep cron as the sole CLI token
options.body: Decline the new public command surface and retain the existing scheduler wording until a naming decision is accepted.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the additive alias
recommendation.body: Adopt `openclaw automations` as the preferred documented command while retaining `openclaw cron` as a supported compatibility token.

likelyOwner.reason: They proposed the coordinated scheduler naming direction and can supply its RFC context, though final acceptance requires a repository decision maker.
